predictor.notes: Best-supported reconstruction: three continuous linear bands, in pence, for integer quantities 1..1000. All 96 responses across 93 distinct quantities matched this predictor exactly and reported roundingCents=0, including the approved quote at 50 and approved export at 200. Validation covered both endpoints, every quantity 267..271 and 625..629, and adaptively selected non-round quantities throughout the range. No observed evidence required curvature or additional bands. Used 96 business requests and 8 REA operations, including inspection. The remaining 907 quantities are predictions, not observations; undetected deviations between sampled quantities cannot be ruled out.
